visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up macro shot of a black cast-iron skillet resting on a wooden tray. Inside are four slices of seared beef with visible pink centers, alongside a green bell pepper, a whole orange carrot, a halved yellow potato, and a wedge of green-skinned pumpkin. Steam rises from the hot dish as a thick brown sauce covers the base. (2) Medium shot of a female character with long dark hair, wearing a white short-sleeved button-up shirt and a dark green tie. She sits in a brightly lit indoor room with orange textured curtains in the background. She holds two wooden spoons and performs a series of rhythmic, dance-like arm movements while winking and smiling at the camera. (3) The camera captures close-up shots of the woman as she makes a square frame with her hands around her eyes, winks, and then transitions to making small 'finger hearts' with her thumbs and index fingers. She continues to smile and move rhythmically. (4) Close-up shot of a wooden ladle dipping into a ceramic pot filled with steaming brown curry sauce. The liquid is poured back in, showing its smooth, thick consistency. Blurred white bowls with rice are visible in the shallow-focus background. (5) The woman is shown in a medium shot, cup-shaping her hand to her mouth as if shouting. She then makes two-handed 'V' signs near her cheeks, blinking and laughing. A subsequent close-up shows chopsticks lifting a slice of medium-rare beef. (6) The woman eats a piece of meat and chews with an expression of intense satisfaction. She then makes a large heart shape by touching her hands above her head. (7) Final graphic screen with the brand logo 'TOKIYA 陶板屋' and several food plates including steak, noodles, and soup arranged on a light table.
